description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Papalymo], [Scion's Xenoglossy Damage Tracker] and [Scion's Xenoglossy Level]

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Papalymo
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Scion's Xenoglossy (0~2), removed after using Scion's Xenoglossy two times

description.name: Scion's Xenoglossy Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Scion's Xenoglossy level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Papalymo]

description.name: Scion's Xenoglossy Level
description.text: Keeps track of Scion's Xenoglossy level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Papalymo]
